final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS station_count, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_total FROM station_counts) SELECT c.observstation, c.telescope_count, 1.0 * c.telescope_count / totals.telescope_total AS share, 1.0 * c.telescope_count / totals.telescope_total - 1.0 / totals.station_count AS share_minus_average FROM station_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE 1.0 * c.telescope_count / totals.telescope_total > 1.0 / totals.station_count ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC, c.observstation LIMIT 10
